verdict: Organic activity dropped sharply this week; paid channels remain off.
narrative: No paid advertising ran this period — Meta and Google Ads were fully inactive, so no leads were generated through those channels. Your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, producing 51 total actions over the 28 days, but that activity dropped 54% in the last 7 days compared to the 7 days before, with zero actions recorded on three of the final three days. Search clicks followed the same pattern, falling 53% over the same comparison, pointing to a contraction in organic search visibility. Website sessions held steady, which suggests existing direct and referral traffic is still arriving, but that is masking the organic decline rather than offsetting it. Reactivating paid advertising is the clearest lever to restore lead flow, and steps to do that are underway.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days (calls, direction requests, and website clicks)
drop in Google Business Profile actions in the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days
leads received this period — no paid campaigns were running on any channel

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile and organic search visibility both collapsed in the final days of this period, with zero actions and zero search clicks on October 3–5.
watch_item.fix: Paid campaign reactivation is being prioritized to restore lead flow while organic visibility is monitored for further movement.
